_comment: Every UI string in the prototype, shared by the web scene (Tauri + Electron) and GPUI. Edit text here, never in code. {name} is a placeholder filled by code. Names, versions and credits of maps, tutorials, tools and mods are data, so they live in screens.json.
home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Welcome back, runner · MCSR Ranked
library.title: Leaderboard
library.subtitle: Top 500 · RSG 1.16.1
onboarding.welcome.title: Speedrun Minecraft without the setup pain
onboarding.welcome.body: We'll install the right Minecraft, legal mods and tools for the way you want to run. It takes about 3 minutes and you can change everything later.
onboarding.welcome.have_setup: I already have an instance (import from MultiMC or Prism)
onboarding.signin.title: Sign in with Microsoft
onboarding.signin.body: You need a Minecraft: Java Edition account. We never see your password, and your login is kept in your system's secure storage.
onboarding.signin.browser_hint: Opens microsoft.com and comes back here automatically
onboarding.signin.code_hint: Good for a second device or if the browser doesn't open
onboarding.signin.waiting: Waiting for you to finish in the browser…
onboarding.mode.title: What do you want to run?
onboarding.mode.body: Pick one to start. Modes share files, so adding another one later is quick.
onboarding.java.title: Java and memory
onboarding.java.body: We'll download Java and set the memory runners use. You don't need to install anything yourself.
onboarding.java.memory_hint: 3 GB suits most runners. More isn't faster for 1.16.1.
onboarding.eye.title: Eye measuring
onboarding.eye.body: Finding the stronghold fast needs a tall, zoomed view and Ninjabrain Bot. We'll set it up for you.
onboarding.eye.windows: Toolscreen (Windows): instant resizing and eye zoom inside fullscreen
onboarding.eye.linux: waywall (Linux): resizing, eye zoom and a Ninjabrain overlay
onboarding.eye.ninjabrain: Ninjabrain Bot 1.5.2: calculates the stronghold from your eye throws
onboarding.obs.title: Recording (optional)
onboarding.obs.body: speedrun.com needs a video of every run. If you use OBS, we can add a ready-made scene for it.
onboarding.done.title: You're ready
onboarding.done.body: Your {mode} setup is installed and checked. Have a look at the tutorials first, or jump straight in.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Microsoft accounts on this computer
accounts.status_expired: Sign-in expired · sign in again to play
accounts.storage_note: Your login is kept in {store}. We never see your password.
modes.title: Modes
modes.subtitle: Each mode is a set of shared layers plus a few mods of its own
check.title: Pre-launch check
check.subtitle: {mode} · checks run every launch
check.footer: Mods are compared with legal-builds.csv from the speedrun.com moderators.
check.legal_mods_detail: All {n} mods match the legal list
check.toolscreen_detail: {bad} isn't on the legal list yet. We'll switch to {good}.
practice.title: Practice
practice.subtitle: Maps install into a separate Practice instance, never into your run setups
practice.ranked_tip: MCSR Ranked also has private rooms and weekly-seed practice built in.
learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Hand-picked guides from the community, newest first

submit.subtitle: {time} · {category} · {date}
submit.video_placeholder: Paste a YouTube or Twitch link
submit.rule_video: The video shows the whole run, from world creation to the credits
submit.rule_files: Upload the run files above with your submission
submit.rule_launcher: Speedrunluncher isn't on the allowed launcher list yet (rule A.1.1). Runs made with it can't be accepted until it is.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes save automatically
settings.close_on_launch: Close the launcher while you play
settings.close_on_launch_hint: Frees memory for Minecraft. A small tray icon stays.
game.title: Minecraft is running
game.subtitle: {mode} · started {ago}
game.window_note: The launcher window closes while you play to free memory. Use the tray icon to bring it back.
v3.desc.ranked: 1v1 races on the same seed. You start the queue, private rooms and the Weekly Race in the game.
v3.desc.rsg: A new random world every run. You reset in the game; the launcher collects your times and splits.
v3.desc.fsg: Filtered seeds with a fast start. The FSG mod picks the seed in the game, and you submit with its token.
v3.desc.ssg: Pick one known seed and learn its route by heart.
v3.desc.draftout: 1v1 lockout bingo with a draft, on the newest Minecraft. Matches start in the game.
v3.strip: Your PB, split by split · gold = best segment
v3.note.ranked: Ranked only connects on its newest version, so the launcher updates it before every start.
v3.note.rsg: These are the mods legal for the main speedrun.com board, checked against the official list.
v3.note.fsg: The FSG mod isn't legal on the main RSG board, so FSG gets its own instance.
v3.note.ssg: Set your seed in the game. The launcher keeps the same legal mods as RSG.
v3.note.draftout: Draftout runs on Minecraft 26.3 with Java 25 and its own mod list.
